Runtime source: Unity court catalogue

Fifteen fictional character quests, three stages each. Choices, requirements, shared information and ending recollections are imported from the same structured JSON used by the game.

Each stage records one decision. Later scenes wait one or two calendar days. Decisions award 15, 30 and 60 XP respectively, once. Rereading awards nothing.

These conversations make arrangements and record consequences; they do not themselves create ships, transfer troops or resolve the separate murder investigation.
